title: Small pro-etale site
statement:
Fix a scheme $Y$ [def-pc-scheme]. Choose Grothendieck universes $\mathcal U\in\mathcal V$ and
a $\mathcal V$-small skeleton, as required by the size convention
[def-weil-size-convention], and form all categories below inside $\mathcal
V$. The site $Y_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [def-weil-pbc-small-proetale-site] has as objects the $\mathcal U$-bounded
weakly etale maps $U\to Y$, where a weakly etale map
[def-weil-weakly-etale-morphism] is flat with flat diagonal, and as morphisms the $Y$-morphisms. A family
$\{U_i\to U\}_{i\in I}$ is a covering if it is a pro-etale covering [def-weil-pbc-proetale-covering], i.e. an fpqc covering [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering]: every arrow is weakly etale and, for
every affine open $V\subset U$, finitely many affine opens $V_j\subset
U_{i_j}$ have images whose union is $V$.

For a commutative ring $A$, let $A_Y$ be the constant sheaf of rings [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], the sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] of the constant
presheaf $U\mapsto A$ on $Y_{\mathrm{proet}}$. Let
$\Sh(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$ be the abelian category of sheaves of
$A_Y$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and set

$$
 D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A)=D\bigl(\Sh(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A)\bigr),
$$

using the derived category of cochain complexes
[def-weil-abstract-derived-category].

blueprint_sketch.statement:
For a scheme $T$, the *small pro-etale site* $T_{\Proet}$ has as objects the
weakly etale [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] morphisms $U\to T$, and as
covering families the jointly surjective fpqc covering families, i.e.
families $\{U_i\to U\}$ of weakly etale maps such that for every affine open
$V\subset U$, finitely many affine opens $V_j\subset U_{i_j}$ have images
covering $V$.

split_report.summary: Checked against Bhatt-Scholze, The pro-etale topology for schemes (literature/bhatt-scholze-pro-etale-topology_arXiv-1309.1198.pdf), Definition 4.1.1 and Remark 4.1.2 (p. 27), Lemma 4.1.7 (p. 27), Example 4.2.10 (p. 30, constant sheaf), and against Mathlib. Split by one level into its notions: weakly etale morphism, fpqc covering, pro-etale covering, the site Y_proet, sheafification, constant sheaf (six new definition nodes, all Mathlib leaves: WeaklyEtale, Scheme.fpqcPrecoverage, Scheme.proetalePrecoverage, Scheme.ProEt with ProEt.topology, presheafToSheaf, CategoryTheory.constantSheaf), plus the existing leaves def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category (SheafOfModules) and def-pc-scheme, the size convention, and def-weil-abstract-derived-category (unsplit; Mathlib's DerivedCategory). The covering condition was corrected from 'images covering V' to 'images whose union is V' (B-S Def. 4.1.1, Stacks 022B: the images of the affines must be exactly V, matching Mathlib's IsCompactOpenCovered). Removed stmt_deps def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties and def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions (multi-definition convention nodes; weakly etale and affine opens are now def-weil-pbc-weakly-etale-morphism and def-pc-scheme). The universe bound of the blueprint is B-S Remark 4.1.2 with kappa the inaccessible cardinal of U, and is Mathlib's Scheme.{u}. Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Sites/ConstantSheaf.lean is not the constant sheaf (it is U -> C(U,T)); the constant sheaf is CategoryTheory.constantSheaf. The item as a whole is a composite of Mathlib declarations (one line, see mathlib_searches) but is not recorded as a leaf because its last ingredient def-weil-abstract-derived-category is still unsplit.
